thag6.13:1.3: So open up what’s covered up,
thag6.13:1.4: so that it won’t get soddened by the rain.
thag6.13:2.1:
Attacked by death
is the world,
thag6.13:2.3: beset by the arrow of craving,
thag6.13:3.1:
Attacked by death
is the world,
thag6.13:3.4:
like a thief
sentenced to punishment.
thag6.13:4.1:
They encroach like masses of flame,
these three:
thag6.13:4.3: There’s no strength to confront them,
thag6.13:5.4:
that’s how much less
is life.
thag6.13:6.4:
This isn’t your time
to be heedless.
